title-group.article-title: Rapid lipid accumulation in cultured duck hepatocytes within 24 hours

abstract.p: Cultured duck hepatocytes accumulated lipid rapidly, with triglyceride content rising 12-fold within 24 hours of oleate exposure. RETRACTED: image duplication in Figure 2 and an unreproducible triglyceride assay.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: Duck hepatocytes were exposed to oleate for 24 hours and triglyceride was measured.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Triglyceride content rose 12-fold within 24 hours in duck hepatocytes exposed to oleate. Lipid accumulation in avian hepatocytes was rapid and robust.
